At close zoom, individual track-centreline links become visible. Click a line or node to inspect the attributes present in the archived source.

Data caveats

This is a prototype, not a verified current infrastructure map. The Network Rail GIS archive is explicitly marked out of date. Track geometry represents modelled centreline links; it is not an engineering or safety-critical representation.

The view uses a broad London-area bounding rectangle, not the official Greater London boundary. Station markers are approximate station-complex positions. Background tiles and Leaflet are loaded online.
